info.title: Pandafile API
info.summary: Send large files, collect uploads and get documents signed – from your own code.
info.description:
The Pandafile API is included with Pro and Team. It follows the same rules and limits as the website.

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer pf_live_…` with a key from Dashboard → Domain & API. Keys have a scope (read, write or full). Test keys (`pf_test_…`) create test transfers: nobody is emailed, they expire after 24 hours, count toward no limit, and webhook events say `"livemode": false`.
**Versioning.** Send `Pandafile-Version: 2026-11-27`. Without it a request uses the version its key is pinned to (keys made before 2026-11-27 stay on 2025-06-01). Versions: 2025-06-01 – The original API. Errors are {"error": "<message>"} (in the language of Accept-Language). Lists that existed then keep their keys (GET /transfers → transfers + next, GET /hooks → hooks, GET /events → events) with has_more and next_cursor added. POST /transfers answers 200. 2026-11-27 – Errors are {"error": {"type", "code", "message", "param"?}} with English messages. Every list is {"object": "list", "data": [...], "has_more", "next_cursor"}. Creating anything answers 201.
**Errors.** `{"error": {"type", "code", "message", "param"?}}` with the HTTP status. Every response has `X-Request-Id` (send your own to correlate).
**Rate limits.** 120 requests per minute per key (burst 120), reported in RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset; 429 comes with Retry-After.
**Idempotency.** Send `Idempotency-Key: <unique string>` with POST, PATCH and PUT. Retrying with the same key and body within 24 hours replays the first response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different body gives 409.
**Pagination.** Lists take `limit` (1–100) and `starting_after` (the `next_cursor` of the previous page) and return `has_more`.
**Uploads.** Files go to the tus endpoint returned when you create a transfer (resumable, any size your plan allows).

post.description: Pandafile downloads each https URL itself (public addresses only, at most 3 redirects, up to your plan's per-transfer limit), creates the transfer and completes it – the way Zapier and Make send files. Waits up to 20 seconds: 201 with status "ready", or 202 with status "uploading" while big files keep downloading in the background (progress: GET /transfers/{id}/import). If a download fails, the transfer is deleted and the import reports the error. With a test key the transfer is test data (nobody is emailed, 24-hour expiry).

202.description: Accepted: the files are still downloading (status "uploading"). The transfer.ready webhook fires when it is done.

post.description: Deliveries are signed (header Pandafile-Signature, see the guide) with the secret in the response, shown once. Ends when the key is revoked.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the dashboard. Scopes: read – GET requests only. write – Read, plus create / change / delete transfers, file requests, signature requests and hook subscriptions. full – Everything, including account settings: branding and team invites.

PandafileVersion.name: Pandafile-Version
PandafileVersion.description: API version (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the key's pinned version.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key (1–255 visible characters) so a retry never does the work twice. Kept 24 hours.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifies this request (quote it when you contact support).

Pandafile-Version.description: The version this response was written in.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the full limit is available again.

Error.description: Error. type: invalid_request_error – The request was wrong: a missing or invalid parameter, an unknown id, or a state that does not allow it. authentication_error – No API key, or the key is unknown, revoked or malformed. permission_error – The key is valid but may not do this (plan, key scope, test mode, team role). idempotency_error – The Idempotency-Key was used before with a different request, or that request is still running. rate_limit_error – Too many requests for this key. Wait Retry-After seconds. api_error – Something went wrong on our side. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. resource_missing, parameter_invalid, plan_required, scope_insufficient, test_mode_unsupported, rate_limited, idempotency_key_reused.

param.description: The parameter or header that caused the error, when known.

error.description: Message in the language of Accept-Language (API version 2025-06-01 only).

storage_bytes.description: Live storage (everything not yet expired counts until it expires).

plan.description: Effective plan right now: team for a Team owner, pro for Pro and for members of an active team.

own_plan.description: What the account pays for itself.

maxTransferBytes.description: Same as limits.max_transfer_bytes (kept for API version 2025-06-01).

expiryDays.description: Same as limits.expiry_days (kept for API version 2025-06-01).

week_bytes.description: Bytes sent in the last 7 days (test mode excluded).

month_bytes.description: Bytes uploaded this calendar month (the fair-use counter).

storage_bytes.description: Bytes your live transfers hold now.

week_transfers.description: Transfers sent in the last 7 days.

api_version.description: Version this response was written in.

dns.description: Records to create at your DNS provider.

files.description: The files you are going to upload (1–500).

recipients.description: Emailed a personal link when the transfer completes (never in test mode).

ownerToken.description: Secret for the tus uploads (metadata ownerToken) and for completing. Shown once.

url.description: Share link (your own domain when connected).
https URL of the file. Redirects (at most 3) are followed; every hop must be a public https address.

name.description: File name to use (default: from Content-Disposition, else the last part of the URL path).

recipients.description: Emailed a personal link when the transfer is ready (never in test mode). Array, or one string separated by commas.

expires_at.description: Expiry (ISO 8601), from 1 hour up to 90 days from now. Not for test keys.

async.description: true: answer 202 straight away instead of waiting up to 20 seconds for the files.

TransferFromUrl.description: Empty optional fields (null or "") count as not given – no-code tools send them that way.

status.description: downloading → ready, or failed (the transfer is then deleted).

bytes_total.description: null while the size is unknown.

anyOf.description: Same fields as an API error (type, code, message, param, reason).

status.description: ready (201) or uploading (202: still downloading – watch GET /transfers/{id}/import or the transfer.ready webhook).

url.description: Share link (works once the transfer is ready).

can_send_again.description: The transfer can be sent again as a new transfer from the dashboard ("Send again"): live, your own share link (not a file request upload), not test data and not end-to-end encrypted.

max_expires_at.description: The latest expires_at this transfer can be given (PATCH expires_at or extend): created_at plus your plan's max_expiry_days. null when the transfer is not live (still uploading, expired, deleted or blocked), is test data, or your plan cannot change the expiry.

expires_at.description: Later expiry, at most 90 days after the transfer was sent (Pro/Team): the transfer's max_expires_at.

extend.description: true: 30 more days (same as the dashboard button), within the same 90 days.

password.description: Set (4–200 characters) or clear (null or "") the download password.

enabled.description: Approvals are on for transfers sent on Pro/Team.

message.description: Shown on the upload page, up to 1000 characters.

example.title: Photos from the wedding
example.message: Drop your best shots here – thank you!

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the page width (0–1).

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the page height.

w.description: Width as a fraction of the page width.

h.description: Height as a fraction of the page height.

lang.description: Language of the signer emails and page (en, de, fr, …).

fields.description: Replaces the fields; every signer needs a signature field to send.

downloadable.description: The signed PDF can be downloaded.

value.description: Text value, or the dashboard image path for signatures.

teamManaged.description: Members of a team see the owner's branding read-only.

emails.description: 1–10 addresses; each gets an email with a join link.

livemode.description: false for events about test-mode transfers.

all_downloads.description: Every download, not only the first per recipient.

url.description: https URL that receives the events (Zapier: target_url).
